comment: The position mapping is at VideoOut.cpp:82-89: in the bipolar setting the voltage divided by ten plus a half is multiplied by the screen size, so -5V is the left or top edge and +5V the right or bottom; in the unipolar setting 0V to 10V covers the same span. Colour is clamped between 0 and 0.999 and multiplied by 256 (lines 106-115), so voltages past the ends of the range are held at black and white rather than wrapping. The separate window is redrawn once every sampleRate/30 samples (line 152). The panel display and the pop-out window hold their own copies of the image, which is why the code keeps two 'resolution changed' flags.
